# Raw API & Other Commands

## jira api

Call Jira REST API endpoints directly for operations that do not yet have
first-class commands.

Supports Jira REST API v2, v3 (Cloud), and Agile/Software REST API.

### Usage

```
jira api <path> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--field` | `-F` | Add JSON body field (`key=value`, repeatable) |
| `--header` | `-H` | Add an HTTP request header (`Key: Value`) |
| `--input` | `-d` | Raw JSON string to use as the request body |
| `--method` | `-X` | HTTP method (default `GET`; auto-switches to `POST` when a body is supplied) |
| `--param` | `-P` | Append query parameter (`key=value`, repeatable) |

### Inherited Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--context` | `-c` | Active Jira context name |
| `--json` | | Pretty-print JSON response |
| `--jq` | | Apply a jq expression to JSON output |

### REST API Base Paths

| API | Base path |
|---|---|
| Jira REST v3 (Cloud) | `/rest/api/3/` |
| Jira REST v2 (DC / Cloud) | `/rest/api/2/` |
| Jira Agile / Software | `/rest/agile/1.0/` |
| Jira Service Management | `/rest/servicedeskapi/` |

### Examples

```bash
# Get issue
jira api /rest/api/3/issue/MYPROJ-42 --json

# JQL search
jira api /rest/api/3/search \
  --param "jql=project=MYPROJ AND status='In Progress'" \
  --param maxResults=10 \
  --json

# Get project
jira api /rest/api/3/project/MYPROJ --json

# Get available transitions
jira api /rest/api/3/issue/MYPROJ-42/transitions --json

# Trigger a transition (POST)
jira api /rest/api/3/issue/MYPROJ-42/transitions \
  --method POST \
  --field transition='{"id":"31"}'

# Add a comment (POST)
jira api /rest/api/3/issue/MYPROJ-42/comment \
  --method POST \
  --field body='{"type":"doc","version":1,"content":[{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Hello from API"}]}]}'

# List sprints for board 10
jira api /rest/agile/1.0/board/10/sprint --param state=active --json

# Get custom field metadata
jira api /rest/api/3/field --json | jq '.[] | select(.custom == true) | {id, name}'

# Bulk update — set fix version on multiple issues
jira api /rest/api/3/issue/bulk \
  --method POST \
  --input '{"issueUpdates":[{"issueIdOrKey":"MYPROJ-42","update":{"fixVersions":[{"set":[{"name":"v2.0"}]}]}}]}'
```

## jira version

Print the installed version of the `jira` CLI.

### Usage

```
jira --version
```

---

## jira completion

Generate shell completion scripts.

### Usage

```
jira completion <shell>
```

Supported shells: `bash`, `zsh`, `fish`, `powershell`

### Examples

```bash
# Bash
jira completion bash >> ~/.bashrc

# Zsh
jira completion zsh >> ~/.zshrc

# Fish
jira completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/jira.fish
```
